body:
I managed to do that on several demos already, using your `inviewport` library. It still requires a bit of hacky code (until https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/903 is fixed. I'll submit a PR to take care of that).

I'm not sure this is something we should include in the core (it requires an external lib, and will need a few options to configure). Maybe I could just write a guide about how to implement that?
